segments.text:
V. 14.
Shake off the duſt from your feet—The Jews thought the Land of Iſrael ſo peculiarly holy, that when they came Home from any heathen Country, they ſtopped at the Borders and ſhook or wiped off the Duſt of it from their Feet, that the Holy Land might not be polluted with it. Therefore the Action here enjoined was a lively Intimation, That thoſe Jews who had rejected the Goſpel, were holy no longer, but were on a Level with Heathens and Idolaters.
